about: What the default character can do (the Character prefab, with its model's collider), measured by running its movement (MovementController.Capabilities): the limits the movement checks hold a level's gaps, climbs, stairs, ramps and clearances to. Written by Tools > Character Showcase > Level > Specs > Write Movement Envelope: don't edit it. The ramp gradient is the levels' rule (GrayboxSettings' Max Ramp Gradient), not the character's limit.
